description: Use when preparing for a Salesforce seasonal release — triaging release notes, reviewing Release Updates, opting into Sandbox Preview, and communicating change impact to stakeholders. Triggers: 'upcoming Salesforce release', 'release notes triage', 'Release Updates', 'sandbox preview opt-in', 'release readiness checklist', 'production upgrade date', 'feature impact', 'critical update', 'roll out the Spring release safely', 'is our org ready for the Spring release', 'release update settings metadata', 'FlowSettings release update field', 'release run sheet', 'preview sandbox refresh freeze', 'settings deploy flipped a release update'. Also covers: which Release Updates are deployable as Settings metadata, the release run sheet artefact, and the preview opt-in refresh-date rule. NOT for planning your own release train — use devops/release-management. NOT for user training and go-live comms — use admin/change-management-and-training.
inputs: Org edition and enabled feature areas (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Flow, Apex, etc.)
List of active automations, Apex code, integrations, and critical business processes
Sandbox inventory and which sandboxes are candidates for preview opt-in

Salesforce Help — Asynchronous Sharing Recalculation After Group Membership or Role Changes (Knowledge Article 005103630): https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=005103630&language=en_US&type=1 — confirms the Summer '25 introduction and completed enablement in all orgs in April 2026, that group and role changes still process synchronously, the Setup Audit Trail rows, the narrow scope ("Most group membership or role changes don't lead to asynchronous sharing recalculation"), and the "Update Apex Code and Flows for Changed Sharing Recalculation Behavior" release update (available Spring '26, enforced Spring '27). (verified 2026-08-13)

Salesforce Help — FAQs: Prepare for the Enforcement of the "Restrict User Access to Run Flow" Salesforce Release Update (Knowledge Article 001930084): https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=001930084&language=en_US&type=1 — confirms enforcement in Winter '26 after postponement from Winter '25, the deprecation of the FlowSites org permission, and that running a user-launched flow (screen or autolaunched) requires Run Flows (or Manage Flow) from a profile or permission set, while record-triggered, scheduled-triggered and platform-event-triggered flows are unaffected. (verified 2026-08-13)

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62) — `Settings` overview: all org settings types are addressed through the single `Settings` name and the member is the type name minus the `Settings` suffix; filename format `<feature>.settings` (api_meta.txt L108361–108378). Supports the `package.xml` in `worked-examples.md` §5 and the "What Part of a Release Update Is Actually Metadata" concept in SKILL.md. https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62) — `FlowSettings` fields and sample definition: `doesEnforceApexCpuTimeLimit` "Corresponds to the Accurately Measure the CPU Time Consumption of Flows and Processes release update" (L116849–116853); `isTimeResumedInSameRunContext` (L117048–117054); `Flow.settings` file location (L116823); sample definition (L117060–117076). Supports the `Flow.settings` block in `worked-examples.md` §4 and Gotcha 9.

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62) — `ApexSettings` fields and sample: `enableAuraApexCtrlGuestUserAccessCheckPref` (L110753–110758), `enableAuraApexCtrlAuthUserAccessCheckPref` (L110747–110752), `enableApexCtrlImplicitWithSharingPref` (L110736–110741), and `enableSecureNoArgConstructorPref` documented as "Not used. Critical update is automatically enforced" (L110831–110833). Also the wildcard rule: the `*` character "applies only when retrieving all settings, not for an individual setting" (L110860–110864). Supports the `Apex.settings` block, the retrieve guidance in §6, and Gotchas 9 and 10.

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62) — `LightningExperienceSettings`: `enableStackedModalManagerEnabled` corresponds to the Enable LWC Stacked Modals release update, default `false` for orgs created before Summer '24 (L121509–121514); `enableAuraSecStaticResCRUCPref` corresponds to Enable Secure Static Resources for Lightning Components (L121395–121401); file suffix and folder (L121340–121343). Supports the `LightningExperience.settings` block in `worked-examples.md` §4.

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62) — `MyDomainSettings.useStabilizedSandboxMyDomainHostnames`: corresponds to the Stabilize the Hostname for My Domain URLs in Sandboxes release update, "enforced in Summer '20"; "As of API version 49.0, this field's value is always true, regardless of the value that you set. Changing its value has no effect on Salesforce, even if it reads false" (L122427–122440). Sibling case `useEnhancedDomainsInSandbox` (L122398–122407). Sole source for Gotcha 10.

Apex Developer Guide (v62) — Apex Code Versions: classes and triggers are stored with version settings for a specific Salesforce API version so a class "is still bound to versions with specific, known behavior" (apexdev.txt L6876–6884); guidance to consolidate to the minimal number of API versions (L6905–6910); *Apex Versioned Behavior Changes* appendix, including the API 67.0 user-mode, sharing-default and `WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED` changes (L44482, L44493–44503). Sole source for Gotcha 12 and the API-version check in the checker. https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf

Apex Developer Guide (v62) — Block Execute Anonymous from Managed Packages: the restriction applies outright to namespaces created in Summer '26 and later, and "For existing managed packages with namespaces created in Spring '26 and earlier, this restriction is enforced as a release update," available Summer '26 and enforced Summer '27 (apexdev.txt L14817–14822). Supports the available/enforced pattern in the `RU-EXEC-ANON-PKG` run-sheet row.

Object Reference for Salesforce (v62) — searched for a `ReleaseUpdate` or sandbox-preview object; there is none (`grep -ci releaseupdate object_reference.txt` returns 0, and "sandbox preview" appears nowhere in either the Object Reference or the Metadata API guide). This is the grounding for the statement in SKILL.md that Setup > Release Updates is a screen with no queryable object behind it, and for keeping preview mechanics as practice with Help citations. https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf

`skills/admin/sandbox-strategy/SKILL.md` › Type Capacities and Refresh Windows and What Your Org Actually Owns — sandbox refresh floors per type and edition entitlements. Cited rather than restated in `worked-examples.md` §3 and §7 and in Gotcha 11.
